column1: # repo-hygiene allowlist for bin/verify-repo-hygiene (HYG-02)
# Format: <scope>\t<literal>\t<reason>
# - <scope> is `.` (repo-wide), a repo-relative directory ending in `/`, or
#   a repo-relative file path. No leading `/`, no glob characters.
# - <literal> is a substring of a HIT token this entry covers. A hit is
#   covered when the token starts with the literal and, if the literal
#   does not end in `/`, the next token byte is `/` or end-of-token.
# - <reason> must be at least 20 characters and explain why the covered
#   path is a runner/cache/tool-install path, never a person's home
#   directory.
# Unused-entry rule: every entry must cover at least one HIT in the
# tracked tree, or the guard fails with `UNUSED allowlist entry <scope>
# <literal>`. The sole exception: an entry scoped to exactly `.planning/`
# is reported as inert (not failed) when the tracked tree has no
# `.planning/` file at all — the public PR-branch case, where `.planning/`
# is filtered out of the branch entirely.
# This file is excluded from the tree scan itself; its comment lines and
# third (reason) fields are scanned separately with the same patterns, so a
# comment or reason that itself contains a machine-local path is a finding
# (exit 1), not silently allowed.
# No entry below may allowlist a person's home directory. See
# bin/verify-repo-hygiene's header for the full contract.
